pipes.name: condition-size-gate
pipes.description: Sifting node only fires when input exceeds 5000 chars. Small inputs pass through untouched.

pipes.name: condition-size-small-gate
pipes.description: Sifting node only fires when input is BELOW 500 chars.

pipes.name: condition-artifact-pipe
pipes.description: Node skipped if artifact already exists on disk — prevents double-processing.

pipes.name: condition-artifact-exists-pipe
pipes.description: Node only fires if artifact IS present on disk.

pipes.name: condition-contains-error-pipe
pipes.description: Heavy sifting node only fires when input contains the string ERROR.

pipes.name: condition-fail-open-pipe
pipes.description: Node with unknown predicate — must warn and still execute (fail-open).
